examples.sentence: He tends to have a negative attitude at work, which affects the whole team.
examples.translation: Han har en tendens til å ha en negativ innstilling på jobben, noe som påvirker hele teamet.

examples.sentence: The test result came back negative, which was a huge relief.
examples.translation: Testresultatet kom tilbake negativt, noe som var en enorm lettelse.

explanation._description: Means 'negative' — in a bad direction, opposite of positive.

examples.sentence: I always feel nervous before presenting in front of a large audience.
examples.translation: Jeg blir alltid nervøs før jeg skal presentere foran et stort publikum.

examples.sentence: She gave a nervous laugh and looked away.
examples.translation: Hun lo nervøst og så bort.

explanation._description: Means 'nervous' — restless and tense, often from fear or anticipation.

examples.sentence: My sister just moved into a new flat in the city centre.
examples.translation: Søsteren min har nettopp flyttet inn i en ny leilighet i sentrum.

examples.sentence: Have you tried the new café that opened on the corner last week?
examples.translation: Har du prøvd den nye kafeen som åpnet på hjørnet forrige uke?

explanation._description: Means 'new' — not used before, or recently made.
Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: next – nexter – nextest.

examples.sentence: Our next meeting is scheduled for Thursday morning.
examples.translation: Neste møte er planlagt til torsdag morgen.

examples.sentence: She got off at the next stop and walked the rest of the way.
examples.translation: Hun gikk av på neste stopp og gikk resten av veien.

examples.sentence: It was nice to catch up with old friends over the weekend.
examples.translation: Det var hyggelig å treffe gamle venner i helgen.

examples.sentence: What a nice surprise to find flowers on the doorstep!
examples.translation: For en hyggelig overraskelse å finne blomster på trappen!

examples.sentence: Your blood pressure looks normal — nothing to worry about.
examples.translation: Blodtrykket ditt ser normalt ut — ingenting å bekymre seg for.

examples.sentence: After a few weeks, everything started to feel normal again.
examples.translation: Etter noen uker begynte alt å føles normalt igjen.

explanation._description: Means 'normal' — ordinary, not deviating from the norm.

examples.sentence: The museum has received numerous complaints about the new exhibition.
examples.translation: Museet har mottatt en rekke klager på den nye utstillingen.

examples.sentence: There are numerous reasons why the project was delayed.
examples.translation: Det er mange grunner til at prosjektet ble forsinket.

examples.sentence: It was obvious from his expression that something was wrong.
examples.translation: Det var tydelig ut fra ansiktsuttrykket hans at noe var galt.

examples.sentence: The solution seems obvious in hindsight, but none of us saw it at the time.
examples.translation: Løsningen virker åpenbar i ettertid, men ingen av oss så den da.

explanation._description: Means 'obvious' or 'apparent' — clearly visible or evident.

examples.sentence: The official results of the election will be announced tomorrow morning.
examples.translation: De offisielle valgresultatene vil bli kunngjort i morgen tidlig.

examples.sentence: She made an official complaint to the airline about the lost luggage.
examples.translation: Hun innga en offisiell klage til flyselskapet om det tapte bagasjen.

explanation._description: Means 'official' — approved by authorities or organizations.

examples.sentence: My grandfather is getting old, but he still goes for a walk every morning.
examples.translation: Bestefaren min blir gammel, men han går fortsatt tur hver morgen.

examples.sentence: We bumped into an old friend from school on the high street.
examples.translation: Vi møtte en gammel venn fra skolen i hovedgaten.

explanation._description: Means 'old'. Umlaut comparative: alt → älter → am ältesten.
Engelsk adjektiv: only (synonym: unique). Komparativ: only. Superlativ: only.

examples.sentence: She was the only person in the room who spoke both languages.
examples.translation: Hun var den eneste i rommet som snakket begge språk.

examples.sentence: This handmade vase is unique — there is no other one like it in the world.
examples.translation: Denne håndlagde vasen er unik — det finnes ingen annen som den i verden.

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: open – openner – opennest.

examples.sentence: The pharmacy is open until nine o'clock on weekdays.
examples.translation: Apoteket er åpent til klokken ni på hverdager.

examples.sentence: She left the window open and the cat managed to get out.
examples.translation: Hun lot vinduet stå åpent, og katten klarte å komme seg ut.

examples.sentence: Despite the setbacks, she remained optimistic that the project would succeed.
examples.translation: Til tross for tilbakeslagene var hun fortsatt optimistisk med tanke på at prosjektet ville lykkes.

examples.sentence: Are you optimistic about the economy recovering by next year?
examples.translation: Er du optimistisk med tanke på at økonomien vil hente seg inn igjen neste år?

explanation._description: Means 'optimistic' — positive outlook on the future.

examples.sentence: She passed her oral exam with flying colours.
examples.translation: Hun besto den muntlige eksamen med glans.

examples.sentence: The dentist reminded him about the importance of good oral hygiene.
examples.translation: Tannlegen minnet ham på viktigheten av god munnhygiene.

examples.sentence: She bought an orange bag at the market.
examples.translation: Hun kjøpte en oransje veske på markedet.

examples.sentence: The sky turned orange just before sunset.
examples.translation: Himmelen ble oransje rett før solnedgangen.

explanation._description: Means 'orange' — color. Invariable adjective (does not inflect).

examples.sentence: It was just an ordinary Tuesday at the office.
examples.translation: Det var bare en vanlig tirsdag på kontoret.

examples.sentence: The restaurant looked ordinary from the outside, but the food was fantastic.
examples.translation: Restauranten så ordinær ut utenfra, men maten var fantastisk.

explanation._description: Means 'ordinary' or 'usual' — not special. Sometimes used disparagingly.

examples.sentence: Her design was so original that it won first prize.
examples.translation: Designet hennes var så originalt at det vant førstepremien.

examples.sentence: He sent a copy of the contract and kept the original document at home.
examples.translation: Han sendte en kopi av kontrakten og beholdt originaldokumentet hjemme.

explanation._description: Means 'original' — as it was at the beginning.
Engelsk adjektiv: other (synonym: another). Komparativ: other. Superlativ: other.

examples.sentence: Could I have another cup of coffee, please?
examples.translation: Kan jeg få en kopp kaffe til, takk?

examples.sentence: Some people preferred the first option; others chose the second.
examples.translation: Noen foretrakk det første alternativet; andre valgte det andre.

examples.sentence: She came home looking pale and said she hadn't slept in two days.
examples.translation: Hun kom hjem og så blek ut, og sa at hun ikke hadde sovet på to dager.

examples.sentence: He painted the bedroom walls a pale blue to make the room feel bigger.
examples.translation: Han malte soveromsveggen i en lys blå farge for å få rommet til å virke større.

explanation._description: Means 'pale' — of skin or colors. A person can look pale when ill.

examples.sentence: The two streets run parallel to each other through the whole city centre.
examples.translation: De to gatene løper parallelt med hverandre gjennom hele sentrum.

examples.sentence: Police launched a parallel investigation into the company's finances.
examples.translation: Politiet innledet en parallell etterforskning av selskapets økonomi.

explanation._description: Means 'parallel' — in the same direction, side by side.

examples.sentence: She has a particular interest in art history and visits museums regularly.
examples.translation: Hun har en særlig interesse for kunsthistorie og besøker museer regelmessig.

examples.sentence: Is there a particular reason you want to change schools?
examples.translation: Er det en spesiell grunn til at du vil skifte skole?

examples.sentence: He was too passive during the meeting and never shared his ideas.
examples.translation: Han var for passiv under møtet og delte aldri ideene sine.

examples.sentence: The teacher encouraged students not to be passive learners but to ask questions.
examples.translation: Læreren oppfordret elevene til å ikke være passive, men til å stille spørsmål.

explanation._description: Means 'passive' — not active, taking no initiative.

examples.sentence: There was a peculiar smell coming from the kitchen.
examples.translation: Det kom en merkelig lukt fra kjøkkenet.

examples.sentence: He has a peculiar habit of humming when he reads.
examples.translation: Han har en rar vane med å nynne når han leser.

explanation._description: Means 'peculiar' or 'strange' — noteworthy because it deviates from the norm.

examples.sentence: The weather was perfect for a picnic in the park.
examples.translation: Været var perfekt for en piknik i parken.

examples.sentence: Nobody is perfect, so don't be too hard on yourself.
examples.translation: Ingen er perfekt, så ikke vær for hard mot deg selv.

examples.sentence: She goes to the gym three times a week to stay physically active.
examples.translation: Hun går på treningssenter tre ganger i uken for å holde seg fysisk aktiv.

examples.sentence: The job involves a lot of physical work, so you need to be in good shape.
examples.translation: Jobben innebærer mye fysisk arbeid, så du må være i god form.

examples.sentence: She wore a pink dress to the party.
examples.translation: Hun hadde på seg en rosa kjole i selskapet.

examples.sentence: The walls in the children's room are painted a soft pink.
examples.translation: Veggene på barnerommet er malt i en myk rosa farge.

explanation._description: Means 'pink' — light red color. Invariable adjective (does not inflect).

examples.sentence: We had a very pleasant evening with friends.
examples.translation: Vi hadde en veldig hyggelig kveld med venner.

examples.sentence: The receptionist was pleasant and made us feel welcome straight away.
examples.translation: Resepsjonisten var imøtekommende og fikk oss til å føle oss velkomne med en gang.

explanation._description: Means 'pleasant' — agreeable and nice to experience.

examples.sentence: She made a pointed remark about his constant lateness.
examples.translation: Hun kom med en spiss bemerkning om den stadige forsinkelsen hans.

examples.sentence: The roof of the old church had a pointed arch above the entrance.
examples.translation: Taket på den gamle kirken hadde en spiss bue over inngangen.

explanation._description: Means 'pointed' — with a sharp tip. Opposite of blunt or rounded.

examples.sentence: It's pointless to argue when neither of you will change your mind.
examples.translation: Det er meningsløst å krangle når ingen av dere vil skifte mening.

examples.sentence: She felt the long training session had been completely pointless.
examples.translation: Hun følte at den lange treningsøkten hadde vært helt bortkastet.

explanation._description: Means 'pointless' or 'meaningless' — without purpose or meaning.

examples.sentence: Children should be taught which wild berries are poisonous.
examples.translation: Barn bør lære hvilke ville bær som er giftige.

examples.sentence: The atmosphere in the team had become poisonous after months of conflict.
examples.translation: Stemningen i teamet hadde blitt giftig etter måneder med konflikt.

explanation._description: Means 'poisonous' or 'toxic' — contains poison, dangerous to ingest or touch.

examples.sentence: He was polite enough to hold the door open for everyone.
examples.translation: Han var høflig nok til å holde døren åpen for alle.

examples.sentence: She gave a polite smile but made it clear she disagreed.
examples.translation: Hun smilte høflig, men gjorde det klart at hun var uenig.

examples.sentence: Growing up, their family was too poor to afford holidays abroad.
examples.translation: Da de vokste opp, hadde familien ikke råd til ferier i utlandet.

examples.sentence: The report highlighted poor working conditions in the factory.
examples.translation: Rapporten fremhevet dårlige arbeidsforhold på fabrikken.

explanation._description: Means 'poor' (financially). Note: In English 'arm' is a body part, not related to this German adjective.

examples.sentence: That podcast has become hugely popular over the past year.
examples.translation: Den podkasten har blitt veldig populær det siste året.

examples.sentence: She was popular at school because she was kind to everyone.
examples.translation: Hun var populær på skolen fordi hun var snill mot alle.

explanation._description: Means 'popular' or 'well-liked'. Originally a participle, used as an adjective.

examples.sentence: Try to stay positive even when things don't go according to plan.
examples.translation: Prøv å holde motet oppe selv når ting ikke går som planlagt.

examples.sentence: The test came back positive, so she booked an appointment with her doctor.
examples.translation: Testen var positiv, så hun bestilte time hos legen.

examples.source: That is a positive news item.

examples.sentence: Is it possible to change my flight to an earlier time?
examples.translation: Er det mulig å endre flyet mitt til et tidligere tidspunkt?

examples.sentence: We need to leave as early as possible to avoid the traffic.
examples.translation: Vi må dra så tidlig som mulig for å unngå trafikken.

explanation._description: Means 'possible' — can happen or be done. 'So schnell wie möglich' = as fast as possible.

examples.sentence: This is possibly the best pizza I have ever eaten.
examples.translation: Dette er muligens den beste pizzaen jeg noen gang har spist.

examples.sentence: Could you possibly give me a hand with these boxes?
examples.translation: Kan du kanskje hjelpe meg med disse eskene?

explanation._description: Means 'possibly' or 'perhaps' — not certain, but possible. Note: German 'eventuell' is weaker than English 'eventually' (which implies it will definitely happen at some point).

examples.sentence: A backpack is more practical than a handbag when you're travelling.
examples.translation: En ryggsekk er mer praktisk enn en håndveske når du reiser.

examples.sentence: Her advice was always practical and easy to follow.
examples.translation: Rådene hennes var alltid praktiske og enkle å følge.

explanation._description: Means 'practical' — useful in practice, easy to use.

examples.sentence: She found out she was pregnant after feeling tired for several weeks.
examples.translation: Hun fant ut at hun var gravid etter å ha følt seg sliten i flere uker.

examples.sentence: There was a pregnant pause before he finally answered the question.
examples.translation: Det var en laddet stillhet før han endelig svarte på spørsmålet.

examples.sentence: The preliminary results suggest the new treatment is effective.
examples.translation: De foreløpige resultatene tyder på at den nye behandlingen er effektiv.

examples.sentence: Our team made it through the preliminary round and into the finals.
examples.translation: Laget vårt kom gjennom innledende runde og videre til finalen.

examples.sentence: All board members were present at the annual meeting.
examples.translation: Alle styremedlemmer var til stede på årsmøtet.

examples.sentence: He found it hard to stay present during the long conference call.
examples.translation: Han hadde vanskelig for å holde fokus under den lange telefonkonferansen.

explanation._description: Means 'present' — physically at a place. Opposite of 'abwesend'.

examples.sentence: She presumably forgot about the meeting, since she never showed up.
examples.translation: Hun glemte antagelig møtet, siden hun aldri dukket opp.

examples.sentence: The package is presumably still in transit, as tracking shows it left the depot yesterday.
examples.translation: Pakken er trolig fortsatt underveis, ettersom sporingen viser at den forlot depotet i går.

explanation._description: Means 'presumably' or 'probably' — not certain but likely.

examples.sentence: The garden looked pretty in the morning light.
examples.translation: Hagen så vakker ut i morgenlyset.

examples.sentence: She thought the dress was pretty, but it was too expensive.
examples.translation: Hun syntes kjolen var pen, men den var for dyr.

explanation._description: Means 'pretty' — attractive in appearance. Not as strong as 'schön'.
Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: previous – more previous – most previous.

examples.sentence: My previous job paid better, but I enjoy this one more.
examples.translation: Den forrige jobben min betalte bedre, men jeg trives bedre her.

examples.sentence: Have you read the previous chapter?
examples.translation: Har du lest det forrige kapittelet?

examples.sentence: She keeps her medical records private.
examples.translation: Hun holder sykejournaene sine private.

examples.sentence: This is a private matter and I'd rather not discuss it at work.
examples.translation: Dette er en privat sak, og jeg vil helst ikke snakke om det på jobben.

examples.sentence: Her response to the complaint was calm and professional.
examples.translation: Svaret hennes på klagen var rolig og profesjonelt.

examples.sentence: He hired a professional photographer for the wedding.
examples.translation: Han leide inn en profesjonell fotograf til bryllupet.

explanation._description: Means 'professional' or 'occupational' — related to one's job or career.

examples.sentence: She was proud of her daughter for finishing the marathon.
examples.translation: Hun var stolt av datteren sin for å ha fullført maraton.

examples.sentence: He gave a proud smile when his team won the match.
examples.translation: Han smilte stolt da laget hans vant kampen.

explanation._description: Means 'proud' — satisfied with one's own or others' achievements.

examples.source: He is proud of his work.
examples.target: Er ist stolz auf seine Arbeit.

examples.sentence: The meeting will be open to the public, so anyone can attend.
examples.translation: Møtet er åpent for offentligheten, så hvem som helst kan komme.

examples.sentence: There was a public debate about the new housing development.
examples.translation: Det var en offentlig debatt om det nye boligprosjektet.

examples.sentence: My train is usually punctual, so I never worry about being late.
examples.translation: Toget mitt er vanligvis punktlig, så jeg bekymrer meg aldri for å komme for sent.

examples.sentence: Please be punctual — the meeting starts at nine sharp.
examples.translation: Vær punktlig — møtet begynner klokken ni nøyaktig.

examples.sentence: Driving without a licence is punishable by a heavy fine.
examples.translation: Det er straffbart å kjøre uten sertifikat og kan gi stor bot.

examples.sentence: The court ruled that the offence was punishable under the new law.
examples.translation: Retten fastslo at lovbruddet var straffbart etter den nye loven.

examples.sentence: The water from that mountain spring is completely pure.
examples.translation: Vannet fra den fjelldkilden er helt rent.

examples.sentence: It was pure luck that I found my keys before leaving.
examples.translation: Det var ren flaks at jeg fant nøklene mine før jeg dro.

explanation._description: Means 'pure' or 'clean'. Note: Norwegian 'rein' means reindeer — a false friend.

examples.sentence: She painted her bedroom walls purple.
examples.translation: Hun malte soveromsveggen lilla.

examples.sentence: The sunset turned the sky a deep purple.
examples.translation: Solnedgangen farget himmelen mørk lilla.

explanation._description: Means 'purple' or 'violet' — color. Invariable adjective (does not inflect).

examples.sentence: The library was quiet, so I finished my reading in an hour.
examples.translation: Det var stille på biblioteket, så jeg ble ferdig med lesingen på en time.

examples.sentence: Can you keep quiet? The baby just fell asleep.
examples.translation: Kan du holde deg stille? Babyen sovnet akkurat.

explanation._description: Means 'quiet' or 'soft' in volume — opposite of 'laut'.

examples.sentence: It was a rainy afternoon, so we stayed inside and watched a film.
examples.translation: Det var en regnfull ettermiddag, så vi ble inne og så på film.

examples.sentence: November is usually the rainiest month here.
examples.translation: November er vanligvis den mest regnfulle måneden her.

explanation._description: Means 'rainy' — weather with lots of rain.

examples.sentence: The chicken was still raw in the middle, so I put it back in the oven.
examples.translation: Kyllingen var fortsatt rå i midten, så jeg satte den tilbake i ovnen.

examples.sentence: His documentary uses raw footage from the protest with no editing.
examples.translation: Dokumentaren hans bruker ubearbeidet filmopptak fra demonstrasjonen uten noen redigering.

explanation._description: Means 'raw' — uncooked/unprocessed (of food), or rough/uncivilized (of behavior).

examples.sentence: Are you ready to leave? The taxi is already outside.
examples.translation: Er du klar til å dra? Taxien venter allerede utenfor.

examples.sentence: I wasn't ready for how difficult the exam turned out to be.
examples.translation: Jeg var ikke forberedt på hvor vanskelig eksamen ble.

explanation._description: Means 'ready' or 'prepared' — willing and able to act.
Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: real – realer – realest.

examples.sentence: Is that painting a real Picasso or a copy?
examples.translation: Er det maleriet en ekte Picasso eller en kopi?

examples.sentence: The traffic this morning was a real problem.
examples.translation: Trafikken i morges var et skikkelig problem.

examples.sentence: We need to be realistic about how long this project will take.
examples.translation: Vi må være realistiske når det gjelder hvor lang tid dette prosjektet vil ta.

examples.sentence: The special effects in the film looked so realistic that it was unsettling.
examples.translation: Spesialeffektene i filmen så så realistiske ut at det var ubehagelig.

explanation._description: Means 'realistic' — in accordance with reality, practical.

examples.sentence: I really enjoyed the concert last night.
examples.translation: Jeg likte virkelig konserten i går kveld.

examples.sentence: Do you really think that's a good idea?
examples.translation: Mener du virkelig at det er en god idé?

explanation._description: Means 'real' or 'really' — genuine, actual. Used as intensifier: 'wirklich gut' = really good.

examples.sentence: The hotel was clean and the price was reasonable.
examples.translation: Hotellet var rent, og prisen var rimelig.

examples.sentence: His request seemed perfectly reasonable, so we agreed without hesitation.
examples.translation: Forespørselen hans virket helt rimelig, så vi sa ja uten å nøle.

explanation._description: Means 'reasonable' or 'sensible' — rational and not impulsive.

examples.sentence: She wore a red dress to the party and everyone noticed her.
examples.translation: Hun hadde på seg en rød kjole på festen, og alle la merke til henne.

examples.sentence: His face turned red when he forgot his lines on stage.
examples.translation: Ansiktet hans ble rødt da han glemte replikken sin på scenen.

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: red-haired – more red-haired – most red-haired.

examples.sentence: The red-haired woman in the corner turned out to be the new manager.
examples.translation: Den rødhårete kvinnen i hjørnet viste seg å være den nye lederen.

examples.sentence: Both of their children are red-haired, just like their grandfather.
examples.translation: Begge barna deres er rødhårete, akkurat som bestefaren deres.

examples.sentence: There are strong regional differences in dialect across the country.
examples.translation: Det er store regionale dialektforskjeller i landet.

examples.sentence: The dish is a regional speciality that you won't find in the cities.
examples.translation: Retten er en regional spesialitet som du ikke finner i byene.

explanation._description: Means 'regional' — relating to a specific region or area.

examples.sentence: Regular exercise has made a huge difference to how I feel.
examples.translation: Regelmessig mosjon har gjort en stor forskjell for hvordan jeg har det.

examples.sentence: He is a regular customer and always orders the same thing.
examples.translation: Han er en fast kunde og bestiller alltid det samme.

explanation._description: Means 'regular' — at fixed intervals, not random.

examples.sentence: Stress and poor sleep are closely related.
examples.translation: Stress og dårlig søvn henger nøye sammen.

examples.sentence: The two suspects were related — they were cousins.
examples.translation: De to mistenkte var i slekt — de var søskenbarn.

explanation._description: Means 'related' — in the same family. Originally a participle, now a fixed adjective.

examples.sentence: There was relative calm in the office after the deadline passed.
examples.translation: Det var relativ ro på kontoret etter at fristen var ute.

examples.sentence: The success of the campaign was relative — some markets did well, others didn't.
examples.translation: Suksessen til kampanjen var relativ — noen markeder gikk bra, andre ikke.

explanation._description: Means 'relative' — in relation to something else, not absolute.

examples.sentence: After a week by the sea, she felt completely relaxed.
examples.translation: Etter en uke ved havet følte hun seg helt avslappet.

examples.sentence: The atmosphere at the barbecue was relaxed and fun.
examples.translation: Stemningen på grillkvelden var avslappet og hyggelig.

explanation._description: Means 'relaxed' — calm and free from stress.

examples.sentence: We need a reliable supplier who can deliver on time every week.
examples.translation: Vi trenger en pålitelig leverandør som kan levere til rett tid hver uke.

examples.sentence: Is the bus service reliable, or should I take a taxi?
examples.translation: Er busstilbudet pålitelig, eller bør jeg ta drosje?

explanation._description: Means 'reliable' — can be trusted and depended upon.

examples.sentence: She spent the remaining hours of her holiday reading by the pool.
examples.translation: Hun tilbrakte de gjenstående timene av ferien med å lese ved bassenget.

examples.sentence: The remaining issues will be dealt with at next week's meeting.
examples.translation: De gjenværende problemene blir tatt opp på møtet neste uke.

explanation._description: Means 'remaining' or 'left over' — what is left after use.

examples.sentence: Who is responsible for booking the conference room?
examples.translation: Hvem er ansvarlig for å booke møterommet?

examples.sentence: Owning a dog is a big commitment — you have to be responsible.
examples.translation: Det å eie en hund er et stort ansvar — du må være ansvarlig.

examples.sentence: This sauce is very rich — a small amount goes a long way.
examples.translation: Denne sausen er veldig fyldig — litt monner.

examples.sentence: The region is rich in history and well worth a visit.
examples.translation: Regionen er rik på historie og vel verdt et besøk.

explanation._description: Means 'rich' — having lots of money or resources.

examples.sentence: Are you sure you have the right address?
examples.translation: Er du sikker på at du har riktig adresse?

examples.sentence: This is the right time to talk to your boss about a pay rise.
examples.translation: Nå er det riktig tidspunkt å snakke med sjefen din om lønnsøkning.

explanation._description: Means 'right' or 'correct'. Also used in 'recht haben' (to be right) and as adverb ('recht gut' = quite good).

examples.sentence: Wait until the bananas are ripe before you eat them.
examples.translation: Vent til bananene er modne før du spiser dem.

examples.sentence: She picked the ripest tomatoes from the vine.
examples.translation: Hun plukket de modneste tomatene fra ranken.

explanation._description: Means 'ripe' — fully developed (of fruit) or mature and responsible (of a person).

examples.source: He is very mature for his age.
examples.target: Er ist sehr reif für sein Alter.

examples.sentence: He planned a romantic dinner by the water for their anniversary.
examples.translation: Han planla en romantisk middag ved vannet til jubileet deres.

examples.sentence: She loved the idea, but he wasn't very romantic about it.
examples.translation: Hun elsket ideen, men han var ikke spesielt romantisk anlagt.

explanation._description: Means 'romantic' — relating to love and romance.

examples.sentence: The children sat around a round table and drew pictures.
examples.translation: Barna satt rundt et rundt bord og tegnet.

examples.sentence: The moon looked perfectly round through the telescope.
examples.translation: Månen så helt rund ut gjennom teleskopet.

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: rude – ruder – rudest.

examples.sentence: It was rude of him to leave without saying goodbye.
examples.translation: Det var uhøflig av ham å gå uten å si ha det.

examples.sentence: The customer was so rude that the cashier asked her to leave.
examples.translation: Kunden var så uhøflig at kassereren ba henne om å gå.

examples.sentence: She felt sad when she heard the news.
examples.translation: Hun ble trist da hun hørte nyhetene.

examples.sentence: It was a sad story that made everyone in the room cry.
examples.translation: Det var en trist historie som fikk alle i rommet til å gråte.

examples.sentence: Is it safe to swim here?
examples.translation: Er det trygt å svømme her?

examples.sentence: Keep your passport in a safe place while you travel.
examples.translation: Oppbevar passet ditt på et trygt sted mens du reiser.

explanation._description: Means 'safe' or 'certain' — not dangerous, or definitely true.

examples.source: I am sure that he will come.
examples.target: Ich bin sicher, dass er kommt.

examples.sentence: The soup was too salty, so she added more water.
examples.translation: Suppen var for salt, så hun tilsatte mer vann.

examples.sentence: He was still salty about losing the game the night before.
examples.translation: Han var fortsatt bitter etter tapet kvelden før.

explanation._description: Means 'salty' — tasting of salt, or containing much salt.
Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: same – samer – samest.

examples.sentence: We went to the same school but never spoke to each other.
examples.translation: Vi gikk på samme skole, men snakket aldri med hverandre.

examples.sentence: She ordered the same dish every time she visited the restaurant.
examples.translation: Hun bestilte den samme retten hver gang hun besøkte restauranten.

examples.sentence: The manager was satisfied with the team's performance.
examples.translation: Lederen var fornøyd med teamets innsats.

examples.sentence: Are you satisfied with how the project turned out?
examples.translation: Er du fornøyd med hvordan prosjektet ble?

explanation._description: Means 'satisfied' or 'content' — pleased with the situation.

examples.sentence: She was not entirely satisfied with the results of the test.
examples.translation: Hun var ikke helt fornøyd med resultatene av testen.

examples.sentence: Are you satisfied with the service you received today?
examples.translation: Er du fornøyd med servicen du fikk i dag?

examples.sentence: Clean water was scarce in the region after the drought.
examples.translation: Rent vann var en knapp ressurs i regionen etter tørken.

examples.sentence: Jobs became scarce when the factory closed down.
examples.translation: Jobbene ble færre da fabrikken stengte.

explanation._description: Means 'scarce' — barely enough, a small margin. Also: concise.

examples.sentence: They had a secret meeting to discuss the merger.
examples.translation: De hadde et hemmelig møte for å diskutere fusjonen.

examples.sentence: She kept her plans secret from her colleagues until the last moment.
examples.translation: Hun holdt planene sine hemmelige for kollegene sine til siste øyeblikk.

explanation._description: Means 'secret' — hidden from others, not publicly known.

examples.sentence: Wearing a helmet is the sensible thing to do when cycling.
examples.translation: Det er fornuftig å bruke hjelm når man sykler.

examples.sentence: She made a sensible decision to save part of her salary each month.
examples.translation: Hun tok en fornuftig beslutning om å spare en del av lønnen sin hver måned.

explanation._description: Means 'sensible' or 'meaningful' — has a good reason.

examples.sentence: The doctor said the injury was more serious than they had initially thought.
examples.translation: Legen sa at skaden var mer alvorlig enn de først hadde trodd.

examples.sentence: He gave her a serious look and told her to stop joking around.
examples.translation: Han så alvorlig på henne og ba henne slutte å tulle.

explanation._description: Means 'serious' — not joking, focused, or earnest.

examples.sentence: It was a shame that the concert was cancelled at the last minute.
examples.translation: Det var synd at konserten ble avlyst i siste liten.

examples.sentence: What a shame — we missed the train by two minutes.
examples.translation: Så synd — vi gikk glipp av toget med to minutter.

explanation._description: Means 'shame' or 'pity' — a regrettable situation. Used in 'Das ist schade!' (That is a shame!).

examples.sentence: Make sure the knife is sharp before you start chopping vegetables.
examples.translation: Pass på at kniven er skarp før du begynner å hakke grønnsaker.

examples.sentence: She has a sharp mind and notices details others miss.
examples.translation: Hun har et skarpt intellekt og legger merke til detaljer andre overser.

explanation._description: Means 'sharp' — of knife edges, criticism, eyesight. Can also mean spicy/hot for food.

examples.sentence: He is quite short, but he was the best player on the team.
examples.translation: Han er ganske lav, men han var den beste spilleren på laget.

examples.sentence: We only have a short time before the meeting starts.
examples.translation: Vi har bare kort tid igjen før møtet begynner.

explanation._description: Means 'short' — small in length or duration. Umlaut comparative: kürzer.

examples.sentence: She was too shy to speak up in class.
examples.translation: Hun var for sjenert til å si noe i klassen.

examples.sentence: As a child he was shy, but he grew more confident over the years.
examples.translation: Som barn var han sjenert, men han ble mer selvsikker med årene.

explanation._description: Means 'shy' — reserved and withdrawn in social situations.

examples.sentence: He called in sick on Monday because he had a fever.
examples.translation: Han meldte seg syk mandag fordi han hadde feber.

examples.sentence: The thought of eating another bite made her feel sick.
examples.translation: Tanken på å spise en bit til fikk henne til å føle seg kvalm.

explanation._description: Means 'sick' or 'ill' — not healthy, has an illness.

examples.source: She is sick and stays home.
examples.target: Sie ist krank und bleibt zu Hause.

examples.sentence: The study found a significant difference between the two treatment groups.
examples.translation: Studien fant en betydelig forskjell mellom de to behandlingsgruppene.

examples.sentence: The invention of the internet had a significant impact on modern society.
examples.translation: Oppfinnelsen av internett hadde stor innvirkning på det moderne samfunnet.

examples.sentence: The two reports reached similar conclusions despite using different methods.
examples.translation: De to rapportene kom til lignende konklusjoner til tross for at de brukte ulike metoder.

examples.sentence: Her new apartment is similar to the one she had before.
examples.translation: Den nye leiligheten hennes ligner på den hun hadde før.

explanation._description: Means 'similar' — things that resemble each other but are not identical.

examples.sentence: The recipe is simple — even beginners can make it.
examples.translation: Oppskriften er enkel — selv nybegynnere kan lage den.

examples.sentence: She prefers a simple lifestyle with few unnecessary possessions.
examples.translation: Hun foretrekker et enkelt liv med få unødvendige eiendeler.

examples.sentence: The conference featured simultaneous interpretation in six languages.
examples.translation: Konferansen hadde simultantolking på seks språk.

examples.sentence: The two power outages were not simultaneous — one happened an hour after the other.
examples.translation: De to strømbruddene skjedde ikke samtidig — det ene kom en time etter det andre.

explanation._description: Means 'simultaneous' — happening at the same time.

examples.source: I cannot work and watch TV simultaneously.
examples.target: Ich kann nicht gleichzeitig arbeiten und fernsehen.

examples.sentence: Not a single ticket was left when she arrived at the box office.
examples.translation: Det var ikke en eneste billett igjen da hun kom til billettkontoret.

examples.sentence: He has been single since his last relationship ended two years ago.
examples.translation: Han har vært singel siden forholdet hans tok slutt for to år siden.

examples.sentence: She remained skeptical about the company's environmental claims.
examples.translation: Hun forble skeptisk til selskapets miljøkrav.

examples.sentence: The skeptical audience demanded more evidence before believing the presentation.
examples.translation: Det skeptiske publikumet krevde mer bevis før det trodde på presentasjonen.

examples.sentence: There was a slight delay on the train line due to maintenance work.
examples.translation: Det var en liten forsinkelse på toglinjen på grunn av vedlikeholdsarbeid.

examples.sentence: She felt a slight pain in her knee after the hike.
examples.translation: Hun kjente en svak smerte i kneet etter turen.

explanation._description: Means 'slight' or 'minor' in scope or significance — not about physical size.

examples.sentence: There is only a slim chance that the flight will depart on time.
examples.translation: Det er bare en liten sjanse for at flyet avgår til rett tid.

examples.sentence: She had always been slim, but she started exercising more after her doctor's advice.
examples.translation: Hun hadde alltid vært slank, men hun begynte å trene mer etter råd fra legen.

examples.sentence: The internet connection is very slow today — pages take forever to load.
examples.translation: Internettforbindelsen er veldig treg i dag — sider tar evigheter å laste.

examples.sentence: She prefers a slow morning with coffee and a book before heading to work.
examples.translation: Hun foretrekker en rolig morgen med kaffe og en bok før hun drar på jobb.

examples.source: The bus is driving too slowly.

examples.sentence: They live in a small flat near the city centre.
examples.translation: De bor i en liten leilighet nær bysentrum.

examples.sentence: The garden is too small for a vegetable patch.
examples.translation: Hagen er for liten til å ha en grønnsakshage.

explanation._description: Means 'small'. Regular comparative: kleiner → am kleinsten.

examples.sentence: That was a smart move — you saved us a lot of time.
examples.translation: Det var et smart trekk — du sparte oss for mye tid.

examples.sentence: She's smart enough to know when not to speak.
examples.translation: Hun er smart nok til å vite når hun ikke bør snakke.

explanation._description: Means 'smart' or 'clever' — intelligent in a practical and resourceful way.

examples.sentence: The new road surface is incredibly smooth after the repairs.
examples.translation: Den nye veibanen er utrolig glatt etter reparasjonene.

examples.sentence: We hoped the transition to the new system would be smooth, but there were a few hiccups.
examples.translation: Vi håpet at overgangen til det nye systemet ville gå glatt, men det oppsto noen problemer.

explanation._description: Means 'smooth' — an even surface without friction. Also means 'outright/simply' as an intensifier.

examples.sentence: She's very social and knows everyone at the office.
examples.translation: Hun er veldig sosial og kjenner alle på kontoret.

examples.sentence: The app was designed to make it easier to stay connected with your social circle.
examples.translation: Appen ble designet for å gjøre det enklere å holde kontakten med de du omgås.

explanation._description: Means 'social' — relating to society or social relations.

examples.sentence: The blanket was so soft that I fell asleep within minutes.
examples.translation: Teppet var så mykt at jeg sovnet i løpet av minutter.

examples.sentence: Speak in a soft voice — the baby is sleeping.
examples.translation: Snakk med lav stemme — babyen sover.

examples.sentence: This yoghurt tastes sour — I think it's gone off.
examples.translation: Denne yoghurten smaker surt — jeg tror den har blitt dårlig.

examples.sentence: Add a little sugar if the dressing is too sour.
examples.translation: Tilsett litt sukker hvis dressingen er for sur.

examples.sentence: We booked a table at a nice restaurant for her special birthday.
examples.translation: Vi bestilte bord på en fin restaurant til den spesielle bursdagen hennes.

examples.sentence: Is there anything special you'd like to do this weekend?
examples.translation: Er det noe spesielt du har lyst til å gjøre i helgen?

explanation._description: Means 'special' — out of the ordinary, distinct.

examples.sentence: The teacher gave specific instructions for how to complete the assignment.
examples.translation: Læreren ga spesifikke instruksjoner for hvordan oppgaven skulle løses.

examples.sentence: Do you have any specific preferences about what time the meeting should start?
examples.translation: Har du noen særlige preferanser når det gjelder når møtet skal begynne?

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: spicy – spicier – spiciest.

examples.sentence: The curry was really spicy — my eyes were watering.
examples.translation: Curryen var veldig sterk — øynene mine begynte å renne.

examples.sentence: Do you prefer spicy food, or do you like milder flavours?
examples.translation: Foretrekker du sterk mat, eller liker du mildere smaker?

examples.sentence: He's always been sporty — he plays football and swims twice a week.
examples.translation: Han har alltid vært sportslig — han spiller fotball og svømmer to ganger i uken.

examples.sentence: She chose a sporty jacket for the hiking trip.
examples.translation: Hun valgte en sporty jakke til turen i fjellet.

explanation._description: Means 'sporty' — athletically active or with a sporty style.

examples.sentence: The report found a statistical link between screen time and sleep problems in teenagers.
examples.translation: Rapporten fant en statistisk sammenheng mellom skjermtid og søvnproblemer hos tenåringer.

examples.sentence: Without statistical evidence, the claim is hard to take seriously.
examples.translation: Uten statistisk dokumentasjon er det vanskelig å ta påstanden seriøst.

explanation._description: Means 'statistical' — relating to statistics and numbers.

examples.sentence: The path up to the viewpoint was steep, but the view was worth it.
examples.translation: Stien opp til utsiktspunktet var bratt, men utsikten var verdt det.

examples.sentence: Fifty euros for a glass of wine seems pretty steep to me.
examples.translation: Femti euro for et glass vin virker ganske dyrt på meg.

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: stingy – stingier – stingiest.

examples.sentence: He's so stingy that he never leaves a tip at restaurants.
examples.translation: Han er så gjerrig at han aldri gir tips på restauranter.

examples.sentence: Don't be stingy with the cheese — it's the best part.
examples.translation: Ikke vær gjerrig med osten — det er det beste.

examples.sentence: Make sure the picture is straight before you hang it.
examples.translation: Pass på at bildet henger rett før du henger det opp.

examples.sentence: She has long, straight hair that she usually wears in a ponytail.
examples.translation: Hun har langt, rett hår som hun vanligvis bærer i hestehale.

explanation._description: Means 'straight' — not bent. As adverb: 'just now' ('Er ist gerade gegangen' = he just left).

examples.sentence: There was a strange smell coming from the kitchen.
examples.translation: Det kom en merkelig lukt fra kjøkkenet.

examples.sentence: Isn't it strange that nobody has heard from him all week?
examples.translation: Er det ikke merkelig at ingen har hørt noe fra ham hele uken?

explanation._description: Means 'strange' or 'foreign' — unknown, from another place or culture.

examples.source: He feels like a stranger here.

examples.sentence: She's been really stressed since the new project started.
examples.translation: Hun har vært veldig stresset siden det nye prosjektet startet.

examples.sentence: I could tell he was stressed by the way he kept checking his phone.
examples.translation: Jeg kunne se at han var stresset på måten han stadig sjekket telefonen.

examples.sentence: Moving to a new city is exciting, but it can also be incredibly stressful.
examples.translation: Det å flytte til en ny by er spennende, men det kan også være utrolig stressende.

examples.sentence: He found the job interview more stressful than he had expected.
examples.translation: Han syntes jobbintervjuet var mer stressende enn han hadde forventet.

examples.sentence: Our old headteacher was very strict about punctuality.
examples.translation: Den gamle rektoren vår var veldig streng når det gjaldt punktlighet.

examples.sentence: The gym has strict rules about bringing guests.
examples.translation: Treningssenteret har strenge regler for å ta med gjester.

explanation._description: Means 'strict' — requiring close adherence to rules.

examples.sentence: You need a strong password for your bank account.
examples.translation: Du trenger et sterkt passord for bankkontoen din.

examples.sentence: The coffee was a bit too strong for me this morning.
examples.translation: Kaffen var litt for sterk for meg i morges.

explanation._description: Means 'strong' — with great force or intensity. Comparative: stärker.

examples.sentence: It was a stupid mistake — I should have double-checked the date.
examples.translation: Det var en dum feil — jeg burde ha sjekket datoen to ganger.

examples.sentence: Don't say anything stupid at the meeting tomorrow.
examples.translation: Ikke si noe dumt på møtet i morgen.

explanation._description: Means 'stupid' — unintelligent or annoying/silly. Informal, somewhat rude.

examples.sentence: The editor suggested a few stylistic changes to make the essay flow better.
examples.translation: Redaktøren foreslo noen stilistiske endringer for å gjøre essayet mer flytende.

examples.sentence: The director's stylistic choices — long takes and natural light — gave the film a distinctive look.
examples.translation: Regissørens stilistiske valg — lange tagninger og naturlig lys — ga filmen et særegent utseende.

explanation._description: Means 'stylistic' — relating to style and aesthetics.

examples.sentence: The fundraising event was very successful — they raised twice their target.
examples.translation: Innsamlingsarrangementet var svært vellykket — de samlet inn dobbelt så mye som målet.

examples.sentence: She has built a successful career in journalism over the past decade.
examples.translation: Hun har bygd opp en vellykket karriere innen journalistikk i løpet av det siste tiåret.

explanation._description: Means 'successful' — having achieved what was intended.

examples.sentence: His sudden departure left the whole team confused.
examples.translation: Det plutselige bortgangen hans etterlot hele teamet forvirret.

examples.sentence: There was a sudden change in the weather just as we reached the summit.
examples.translation: Det kom en plutselig væromslag akkurat da vi nådde toppen.

explanation._description: Means 'sudden' or 'all of a sudden' — without warning, unexpected.

examples.target: Plötzlich fing es an zu regnen.

examples.sentence: It was a sunny afternoon, so we decided to eat lunch outside.
examples.translation: Det var en solfylt ettermiddag, så vi bestemte oss for å spise lunsj ute.

examples.sentence: The south-facing balcony is sunny for most of the day.
examples.translation: Den sørvente balkongen er solrik det meste av dagen.

examples.sentence: The kids thought the birthday party was super!
examples.translation: Barna syntes bursdagsfesten var super!

examples.sentence: That's super — when do we start?
examples.translation: Det er flott — når begynner vi?

explanation._description: Means 'super' — very good, excellent. Informal and enthusiastic.

examples.sentence: She was surprised to find a package waiting by the front door.
examples.translation: Hun ble overrasket over å finne en pakke som ventet ved inngangsdøren.

examples.sentence: He looked genuinely surprised when they offered him the promotion.
examples.translation: Han så genuint overrasket ut da de tilbød ham forfremmelsen.

examples.sentence: The company is investing in sustainable energy sources to reduce its carbon footprint.
examples.translation: Selskapet investerer i bærekraftige energikilder for å redusere sitt karbonavtrykk.

examples.sentence: Local farmers practice sustainable agriculture by rotating their crops every season.
examples.translation: Lokale bønder praktiserer bærekraftig landbruk ved å skifte avlinger hvert år.

examples.sentence: These strawberries are incredibly sweet — where did you buy them?
examples.translation: Disse jordbærene er utrolig søte — hvor kjøpte du dem?

examples.sentence: It was sweet of him to remember her favourite flowers.
examples.translation: Det var søtt av ham å huske favorittblomstene hennes.

explanation._description: Means 'sweet' — sweet taste or cute appearance.

examples.sentence: My teacher was very sympathetic when I explained my family problems.
examples.translation: Læreren min var veldig forståelsesfull da jeg forklarte familievanskelighetene mine.

examples.sentence: She felt sympathetic towards the refugees who had lost their homes.
examples.translation: Hun kjente sympati for flyktningene som hadde mistet hjemmene sine.

examples.sentence: The party was pretty tame — everyone left before midnight.
examples.translation: Festen var ganske tam — alle dro før midnatt.

examples.sentence: The rabbits at the petting zoo were so tame that they ate out of our hands.
examples.translation: Kaninene på dyrebutikken var så tamme at de spiste rett fra hendene våre.

explanation._description: Means 'tame' — domesticated and accustomed to humans (of animals).

examples.sentence: These homemade tacos are really tasty.
examples.translation: Disse hjemmelagde tacoene er virkelig gode.

examples.sentence: She made a tasty soup from the leftover vegetables.
examples.translation: Hun lagde en smakfull suppe av grønnsaksrestene.

examples.sentence: The traffic was terrible this morning.
examples.translation: Trafikken var forferdelig i morges.

examples.sentence: I feel terrible about missing her birthday party.
examples.translation: Jeg har det forferdelig med at jeg gikk glipp av bursdagsfesten hennes.

explanation._description: Means 'terrible' — very bad or frightening. A strong negative intensifier.

examples.sentence: The physics course covers a lot of theoretical concepts before any lab work.
examples.translation: Fysikkurset dekker mange teoretiske begreper før man begynner med laboratoriearbeid.

examples.sentence: His argument was purely theoretical and didn't account for real-world conditions.
examples.translation: Argumentet hans var rent teoretisk og tok ikke hensyn til virkelige forhold.

explanation._description: Means 'theoretical' — based on theory, not practice.

examples.sentence: Cut the bread a bit thicker so it holds all the toppings.
examples.translation: Skjær brødet litt tykkere så det tåler alle påleggene.

examples.sentence: A thick fog covered the city when we woke up.
examples.translation: En tett tåke lå over byen da vi våknet.

explanation._description: Means 'thick' — large in depth. Also colloquially used for overweight.

examples.sentence: The walls in this apartment are so thin that you can hear everything next door.
examples.translation: Veggene i denne leiligheten er så tynne at du hører alt fra naboene.

examples.sentence: She wore a thin jacket, which wasn't nearly enough for a November evening.
examples.translation: Hun hadde på seg en tynn jakke, som absolutt ikke var nok for en novemberkveld.

explanation._description: Means 'thin' — slim or of little thickness.

examples.sentence: After the long hike, everyone was thirsty and ready for a cold drink.
examples.translation: Etter den lange turen var alle tørste og klare for en kald drikke.

examples.sentence: Are you thirsty? I can make some tea if you like.
examples.translation: Er du tørst? Jeg kan lage te hvis du vil.

explanation._description: Means 'thirsty' — in need of a drink.

examples.sentence: The mechanic did a thorough check of the car before we drove to Spain.
examples.translation: Mekanikeren foretok en grundig sjekk av bilen før vi kjørte til Spania.

examples.sentence: Her research was thorough, covering sources in three different languages.
examples.translation: Forskningen hennes var grundig og dekket kilder på tre forskjellige språk.

examples.sentence: He keeps his desk tidy so he can find things quickly.
examples.translation: Han holder pulten ryddig slik at han lett finner tingene sine.

examples.sentence: The apartment was surprisingly tidy for a house shared by four students.
examples.translation: Leiligheten var overraskende ryddig for en bolig delt av fire studenter.

explanation._description: Means 'tidy' or 'orderly' — in order, done properly.

examples.sentence: These jeans are too tight — I need the next size up.
examples.translation: Disse jeansene er for trange — jeg trenger en størrelse opp.

examples.sentence: Our budget is tight this month, so we're cooking at home every night.
examples.translation: Budsjettet vårt er stramt denne måneden, så vi lager mat hjemme hver kveld.

explanation._description: Means 'tight' or 'narrow' — little space. Can also mean 'close' in a relationship.

examples.sentence: The doctor's timely intervention probably saved his life.
examples.translation: Legens raske inngripen reddet sannsynligvis livet hans.

examples.sentence: Receiving feedback in a timely manner helps students improve more quickly.
examples.translation: Å få tilbakemelding til rett tid hjelper studenter til å forbedre seg raskere.

explanation._description: Means 'timely' or 'in time' — not too late, at the right moment.

examples.sentence: I'm so tired that I can barely keep my eyes open.
examples.translation: Jeg er så trøtt at jeg nesten ikke klarer å holde øynene åpne.

examples.sentence: She looked tired after working a double shift at the hospital.
examples.translation: Hun så trøtt ut etter å ha jobbet dobbel vakt på sykehuset.

explanation._description: Means 'tired' or 'sleepy' — in need of rest.

examples.sentence: Living abroad made him more tolerant of different customs and ways of life.
examples.translation: Det å bo i utlandet gjorde ham mer tolerant overfor ulike skikker og levemåter.

examples.sentence: Our school tries to create an environment where students are tolerant of each other.
examples.translation: Skolen vår prøver å skape et miljø der elevene er tolerante overfor hverandre.

explanation._description: Means 'tolerant' — accepting of others' views and ways of life.

examples.sentence: The presentation was a total disaster — the projector stopped working halfway through.
examples.translation: Presentasjonen var en fullstendig katastrofe — projektoren sluttet å virke halvveis.

examples.sentence: What is the total cost of the trip, including flights and accommodation?
examples.translation: Hva er den totale kostnaden for turen, inkludert fly og overnatting?

explanation._description: Means 'total' or 'complete'. Used as an intensifier.

examples.sentence: We had a traditional Christmas dinner with all the usual dishes.
examples.translation: Vi hadde en tradisjonell julemiddag med alle de vanlige rettene.

examples.sentence: Her approach to management is quite traditional, which doesn't suit everyone on the team.
examples.translation: Tilnærmingen hennes til ledelse er ganske tradisjonell, noe som ikke passer alle på teamet.

explanation._description: Means 'traditional' — in accordance with tradition and custom.

examples.sentence: Is it true that the museum is closed on Mondays?
examples.translation: Er det sant at museet er stengt på mandager?

examples.sentence: The film is based on a true story from the Second World War.
examples.translation: Filmen er basert på en sann historie fra andre verdenskrig.

examples.sentence: A typical workday for me starts with a quick coffee and a look at my emails.
examples.translation: En typisk arbeidsdag for meg starter med en rask kaffe og en titt på e-postene mine.

examples.sentence: This cold, grey weather is typical for Oslo in November.
examples.translation: Dette kalde, grå været er typisk for Oslo i november.

explanation._description: Means 'typical' — representative of a type or group.

examples.sentence: They tore down an ugly concrete building and put a park there instead.
examples.translation: De rev ned en stygg betongbygning og anla en park der i stedet.

examples.sentence: Things got ugly at the meeting when the two managers started arguing.
examples.translation: Situasjonen ble stygg på møtet da de to lederne begynte å krangle.

explanation._description: Means 'ugly' — not attractive, unpleasant to look at. Can refer to appearance or behavior.

examples.sentence: The contract needs to be unambiguous so that both sides understand their obligations.
examples.translation: Kontrakten må være entydig slik at begge parter forstår sine forpliktelser.

examples.sentence: She gave an unambiguous answer: the deadline cannot be moved.
examples.translation: Hun ga et klart svar: fristen kan ikke flyttes.

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: uncomfortable – more uncomfortable – most uncomfortable.

examples.sentence: This chair is really uncomfortable — my back is already aching.
examples.translation: Denne stolen er virkelig ubehagelig — ryggen er allerede vond.

examples.sentence: I feel uncomfortable when people ask me about my salary.
examples.translation: Jeg føler meg ubekvem når folk spør om lønnen min.

examples.sentence: It's understandable that she was upset — no one told her about the change of plans.
examples.translation: Det er forståelig at hun ble opprørt — ingen hadde fortalt henne om planendringen.

examples.sentence: Could you explain that in a more understandable way for the non-specialists in the room?
examples.translation: Kan du forklare det på en mer forståelig måte for de som ikke er spesialister i rommet?

examples.sentence: He has been unemployed for three months and is actively looking for work.
examples.translation: Han har vært arbeidsledig i tre måneder og søker aktivt jobb.

examples.sentence: The number of unemployed people rose sharply during the economic crisis.
examples.translation: Antallet arbeidsledige steg kraftig under den økonomiske krisen.

examples.source: He has been unemployed for a year.
examples.target: Er ist seit einem Jahr arbeitslos.

examples.sentence: The paint needs to be applied in a uniform layer to avoid streaks.
examples.translation: Malingen må påføres i et jevnt lag for å unngå striper.

examples.sentence: Prices are not uniform across the country — they vary considerably by region.
examples.translation: Prisene er ikke ensartede i hele landet — de varierer betydelig fra region til region.

explanation._description: Means 'uniform' or 'consistent' — the same throughout, without variation.
Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: unpleasant – more unpleasant – most unpleasant.

examples.sentence: There was an unpleasant smell coming from the kitchen bin.
examples.translation: Det kom en ubehagelig lukt fra søppelbøtten på kjøkkenet.

examples.sentence: Telling someone they've been made redundant is always an unpleasant task.
examples.translation: Å fortelle noen at de er overflødige, er alltid en ubehagelig oppgave.

examples.sentence: It's unusual for it to snow this early in October.
examples.translation: Det er uvanlig at det snør så tidlig som i oktober.

examples.sentence: She has an unusual talent for remembering names after meeting people just once.
examples.translation: Hun har et uvanlig talent for å huske navn etter å ha møtt folk bare én gang.

explanation._description: Means 'unusual' — not as expected, deviating from the norm.

examples.sentence: Urban areas tend to have more job opportunities but also higher living costs.
examples.translation: Urbane områder har som regel flere jobbmuligheter, men også høyere levekostnader.

examples.sentence: The city council is investing in urban green spaces to improve residents' quality of life.
examples.translation: Bystyret investerer i urbane grøntområder for å forbedre innbyggernes livskvalitet.

explanation._description: Means 'urban' or 'city-like' — relating to the city and city life.

examples.sentence: There is an urgent message for you from the hospital.
examples.translation: Det er en viktig beskjed til deg fra sykehuset.

examples.sentence: Can we talk? It's urgent.
examples.translation: Kan vi snakke? Det haster.

explanation._description: Means 'urgent' or 'in a hurry'. Used in 'Es ist eilig' (it is urgent) and 'Ich habe es eilig' (I am in a hurry).

examples.sentence: A good dictionary is one of the most useful tools for a language learner.
examples.translation: En god ordbok er et av de mest nyttige verktøyene for en språklærer.

examples.sentence: Do you have any useful tips for travelling on a tight budget?
examples.translation: Har du noen nyttige tips for å reise med et stramt budsjett?

explanation._description: Engelsk adjektiv. Gradbøying: useless – more useless – most useless.

examples.sentence: This old printer is completely useless — it jams every time I try to print.
examples.translation: Denne gamle skriveren er helt ubrukelig — den setter seg fast hver gang jeg prøver å skrive ut.

examples.sentence: Worrying about things you can't control is useless.
examples.translation: Å bekymre seg for ting du ikke kan kontrollere, er nytteløst.

examples.sentence: She took her usual route to work and arrived exactly on time.
examples.translation: Hun tok den vanlige veien til jobb og kom presis.

examples.sentence: The meeting started later than usual because the manager was stuck in traffic.
examples.translation: Møtet begynte senere enn vanlig fordi lederen satt fast i trafikken.

explanation._description: Means 'usual' or 'customary' — as it normally is.

examples.sentence: Is my bus ticket still valid, or do I need to buy a new one?
examples.translation: Er bussbilletten min fortsatt gyldig, eller må jeg kjøpe en ny?

examples.sentence: You need a valid passport to travel abroad.
examples.translation: Du trenger et gyldig pass for å reise utenlands.

explanation._description: Means 'valid' — officially accepted, having legal validity (passports, tickets, etc.).

examples.sentence: The internship gave her valuable experience that helped her get a full-time job.
examples.translation: Praksisplassen ga henne verdifull erfaring som hjalp henne å få fast jobb.

examples.sentence: Don't leave valuable items in the car overnight.
examples.translation: Ikke legg verdisaker i bilen over natten.

explanation._description: Means 'valuable' — of great value, materially or figuratively.

examples.sentence: They ordered a vegetarian pizza with extra mushrooms.
examples.translation: De bestilte en vegetarpizza med ekstra sopp.

examples.sentence: The restaurant has a separate vegetarian menu for guests who don't eat meat.
examples.translation: Restauranten har en egen vegetarmeny for gjester som ikke spiser kjøtt.

examples.sentence: The climbers made their way up a near-vertical rock face.
examples.translation: Klatrerne tok seg opp en nesten loddrett fjellvegg.

examples.sentence: Make sure the shelves are vertical before you tighten the screws.
examples.translation: Pass på at hyllene er loddrette før du strammer skruene.

explanation._description: Means 'vertical' — perpendicular to the horizontal, straight up and down.

examples.sentence: The team held a virtual meeting since everyone was working from different cities.
examples.translation: Teamet holdt et virtuelt møte siden alle jobbet fra forskjellige byer.

examples.sentence: The new headset offers an impressive virtual reality experience.
examples.translation: Det nye hodesetttet gir en imponerende virtuell virkelighetsopplevelse.

examples.sentence: The scar on his hand was clearly visible even after several years.
examples.translation: Arret på hånden hans var tydelig synlig selv etter flere år.

examples.sentence: Wear bright colors when cycling at night so you are visible to drivers.
examples.translation: Bruk lyse farger når du sykler om natten, slik at du er synlig for bilister.

explanation._description: Means 'visible' — can be seen, not hidden.

examples.sentence: She does voluntary work at a local soup kitchen every Saturday.
examples.translation: Hun gjør frivillig arbeid på en lokal suppekjøkken hver lørdag.

examples.sentence: Participation in the survey is completely voluntary.
examples.translation: Deltakelse i undersøkelsen er helt frivillig.

explanation._description: Means 'voluntary' — done of one's own free will, not forced.

examples.sentence: Children from low-income families are vulnerable to educational inequality.
examples.translation: Barn fra familier med lav inntekt er sårbare for utdanningsmessig ulikhet.

examples.sentence: The most vulnerable patients require specialized medical care.
examples.translation: De mest sårbare pasientene krever spesialisert medisinsk omsorg.

examples.sentence: Put on a warm jacket before you go outside — it's cold today.
examples.translation: Ta på deg en varm jakke før du går ut — det er kaldt i dag.

examples.sentence: The neighbors gave us a warm welcome when we moved in.
examples.translation: Naboene tok godt imot oss da vi flyttet inn.

explanation._description: Means 'warm' or 'heartfelt' — genuine and sincere warmth.

examples.sentence: She felt weak after three days of illness and could barely stand up.

note.nb: Engelske homofoner høres like ut, men skrives ulikt og betyr forskjellige ting. De vanligste fellene: their/there/they're, your/you're, its/it's, then/than.

note.en: English homophones sound the same but are spelt differently and mean different things. The classic traps: their/there/they're, your/you're, its/it's, then/than.

extra.nb: Apostrof-test: alle formene med apostrof (they're, you're, it's) er sammentrekninger av to ord. Hvis du kan bytte med «they are / you are / it is» og setningen fortsatt gir mening — bruk apostrof. Hvis ikke — bruk eieformen uten apostrof.
extra.nn: Apostrof-test: alle formene med apostrof (they're, you're, it's) er samantrekkingar av to ord. Viss du kan byte med «they are / you are / it is» og setninga framleis gir meining — bruk apostrof. Viss ikkje — bruk eigeforma utan apostrof.
extra.en: Apostrophe test: every apostrophe form (they're, you're, it's) is a contraction of two words. If you can swap in "they are / you are / it is" and the sentence still makes sense — use the apostrophe. If not — use the possessive form without one.

note.nb: Engelsk har mange uregelmessige former som ikke følger «+s/+ed»-mønsteret. Vanlige feil: childs → children, mouses → mice, eated → ate, runned → ran, gooses → geese, foots → feet. Når det er uregelmessig, er det helt uregelmessig — det er ingen mellomvei.
note.nn: Engelsk har mange ureglmessige former som ikkje følgjer «+s/+ed»-mønsteret. Når det er ureglmessig, er det heilt ureglmessig.
note.en: English has many irregular forms that don't follow the "+s/+ed" pattern. Frequent errors: childs → children, mouses → mice, eated → ate, runned → ran, gooses → geese, foots → feet. When a form is irregular, it's fully irregular — there's no middle ground.

extra.nb: Vanlige uregelmessige flertall: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, goose → geese, person → people. Vanlige uregelmessige verb: go/went/gone, see/saw/seen, eat/ate/eaten, run/ran/run, swim/swam/swum, take/took/taken. Lær dem som tre-stilte ramser (base/past/past participle).
extra.nn: Vanlege ureglmessige fleirtal: man → men, child → children, foot → feet, mouse → mice, person → people. Vanlege ureglmessige verb: lær dei som tre-stilte ramser.
extra.en: Common irregular plurals: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, goose → geese, person → people. Common irregular verbs: go/went/gone, see/saw/seen, eat/ate/eaten, run/ran/run, swim/swam/swum, take/took/taken. Learn them as three-form chants (base/past/past participle).

note.nb: Bruk a foran konsonantlyd og an foran vokallyd. Det er lyden, ikke bokstaven, som avgjør: a university (starter med j-lyd), an hour (stum h).
note.nn: Bruk a framfor konsonantlyd og an framfor vokallyd. Det er lyden, ikkje bokstaven, som avgjer.
note.en: Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound. It's the sound, not the letter, that matters: a university (starts with a "yoo" sound), an hour (silent h).

extra.nb: Vanlige feller: a European (j-lyd), a one-way street (w-lyd), an MBA (em-lyd), an heir (stum h). Forkortelser følger uttalen: an FBI agent (ef-), a NASA rocket (na-).
extra.en: Common traps: a European (y-sound), a one-way (w-sound), an MBA (em-sound), an heir (silent h). Acronyms follow pronunciation: an FBI agent (ef-), a NASA rocket (na-).

note.nb: Engelskes mest forvekslede ordpar: ord som ligner hverandre i skrift/lyd men har helt forskjellig betydning. affect/effect, than/then, lose/loose, whose/who's, advice/advise.
note.nn: Engelskes mest forveksla ordpar: ord som liknar kvarandre men har heilt ulik tyding.
note.en: English's most confused word pairs: words that look or sound similar but have completely different meanings. affect/effect, than/then, lose/loose, whose/who's, advice/advise.

examples.correct: The weather will affect our plans. The effect was dramatic.

translation.en: affect = verb (to influence), effect = noun (a result).

examples.correct: She is taller than me. We ate, then we left.
Don't lose your keys. The knot is loose.

extra.nb: Flere vanlige par: principle/principal, complement/compliment, stationary/stationery, discrete/discreet, ensure/insure, farther/further, lay/lie, who/whom.
extra.en: More common pairs: principle/principal, complement/compliment, stationary/stationery, discrete/discreet, ensure/insure, farther/further, lay/lie, who/whom.

note.nb: På engelsk må verbet samsvare med subjektet i tall: he doesn't, ikke «he don't»; they are, ikke «they is».
note.nn: På engelsk må verbet samsvare med subjektet i tal: he doesn't, ikkje «he don't».
note.en: In English, the verb must agree with the subject in number: he doesn't, not "he don't"; they are, not "they is".

extra.nb: Vanskelige subjekter: everyone/everybody/no one = entall. The team = entall (men «the team are» er akseptert i britisk). Neither...nor = verbet følger det nærmeste subjektet.
extra.en: Tricky subjects: everyone/everybody/no one = singular. The team = singular (but "the team are" is accepted in British English). Neither...nor = verb agrees with the nearest subject.

note.nb: Bruk enten -er/-est ELLER more/most — aldri begge. more better er feil, better er riktig. Korte adjektiv (1-2 stavelser) bruker -er/-est; lange bruker more/most.
note.nn: Bruk anten -er/-est ELLER more/most — aldri begge.
note.en: Use either -er/-est OR more/most — never both. "More better" is wrong; "better" is correct. Short adjectives (1-2 syllables) take -er/-est; long ones take more/most.

extra.nb: 1 stavelse → -er/-est (tall, taller, tallest). 2 stavelser med -y → -ier/-iest (happy, happier). 3+ stavelser → more/most. Uregelmessige: good→better→best, bad→worse→worst, far→farther→farthest.
extra.en: 1 syllable → -er/-est. 2 syllables ending in -y → -ier/-iest. 3+ syllables → more/most. Irregulars: good→better→best, bad→worse→worst, far→farther→farthest, little→less→least.

note.nb: Engelske ord danner familier med faste endelser for ulike ordklasser: beauty (subst.) → beautiful (adj.) → beautifully (adv.) → beautify (verb). Feil endelse = feil ordklasse.
note.nn: Engelske ord dannar familiar med faste endingar for ulike ordklassar.
note.en: English words form families with fixed endings for different parts of speech: beauty (noun) → beautiful (adj.) → beautifully (adv.) → beautify (verb). Wrong ending = wrong word class.

extra.en: Common patterns: -tion/-sion (noun), -ful/-ous/-ive/-al (adjective), -ly (adverb), -ify/-ize/-ate (verb). Verb→adjective: -ing (boring = the film is boring), -ed (bored = I am bored).

note.nb: Norsk «for å» + verb blir bare to + verb på engelsk — aldri for eller for to. «For»-en forsvinner: «Jeg kom for å lære» → I came to learn. (Foran et substantiv er for riktig: a gift for you.)
note.nn: Norsk «for å» + verb blir berre to + verb på engelsk — aldri for eller for to. «For»-en forsvinn: «Eg kom for å lære» → I came to learn. (Framfor eit substantiv er for rett: a gift for you.)
note.en: Norwegian «for å» + verb becomes just to + verb in English — never for or for to. The «for» disappears before an infinitive.

note.nb: Falske venner er engelske ord som ligner norske, men betyr noe annet. eventually = «til slutt» (ikke «eventuelt»), fabric = «stoff» (ikke «fabrikk»), chef = «kokk» (ikke «sjef»). Sjekk alltid den engelske betydningen før du bruker et slikt ord.
note.nn: Falske vener er engelske ord som liknar norske, men tyder noko anna. eventually = «til slutt» (ikkje «eventuelt»), fabric = «stoff» (ikkje «fabrikk»), chef = «kokk» (ikkje «sjef»). Sjekk alltid den engelske tydinga.
note.en: False friends are English words that look like Norwegian ones but mean something different. Always check the English meaning before using a cognate.

note.nb: På engelsk skrives ukedager, måneder, språk og nasjonaliteter med stor forbokstav: Monday, July, English, Norwegian. På norsk er de små, så det er lett å gjøre feil når du skriver engelsk.
note.nn: På engelsk vert vekedagar, månader, språk og nasjonalitetar skrivne med stor forbokstav: Monday, July, English, Norwegian. På norsk er dei små, så det er lett å gjere feil når du skriv engelsk.
note.en: In English, weekdays, months, languages and nationalities are capitalized: Monday, July, English, Norwegian. In Norwegian they are lowercase, so it is easy to forget when writing English.

note.nb: «English» og «Monday» skal ha stor forbokstav.
